# UniHub Documentation Templates

This directory contains all official documentation templates used across the UniHub project.

Every new document should start from one of these templates.

---

## Available Templates

### Product

- prd-template.md
- wireframe-template.md
- api-template.md
- task-template.md

### Engineering

- adr-template.md
- database-template.md
- architecture-template.md

### Management

- meeting-template.md
- decision-template.md
- roadmap-template.md

### Quality

- bug-report-template.md
- test-plan-template.md

---

## Rules

- Never create documents from scratch.
- Always use the appropriate template.
- Keep document versions updated.
- Follow the UniHub Documentation Standard (UDS).
